facts.fact: The Centro de Coordenação Integrada de Projetos (CCIP) issued a request for expressions of interest on 4 September 2026, under the USD 29 million IDA-financed health security project P179078, for a firm to train health staff and managers and support implementation and use of the health information system's digital tools, SIS/PORTAL and DHIS2, over six months.

note: Only says a standalone national digital health strategy is under elaboration; names no health management information system.

systems.country_label: DHIS2, named as implemented in human health

note: DHIS2 is named without describing national routine reporting.
Cause-of-death reporting project; DHIS-2 modernisation named only in passing, with no national system stated in service.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health of Cabo Verde says the CCSSIDA handed 62 Global Fund-financed computers to the national health directorate on 12 December 2023 to reinforce the DHIS2 health information system for the country's health delegations and health centres.

note: DHIS2 is named only as a national priority to consolidate; no statement that a national system is in service or being rolled out.
